💡 Key Insights

1. Growth is real but flat: 2025 grew 8.6% over 2024; 2026 (10 months) annualizes to ₹4.27 Cr, roughly flat vs 2025. AOV is ₹24,276.
2. Electronics is the engine: ₹4.47 Cr sales (36.8% share) at a 27.3% margin. 4K Monitor alone is 24.9% of company sales.
3. Discounts destroy margin, not delight customers: average rating is about 4.00 in every band. Zero-discount orders earn 32.7% margin; the >20% band earns 10.1%. Capping deep discounts recovers about ₹387,359.
4. Regional gap: East has the best margin (28.2%) on ₹2.11 Cr sales; North has the weakest (26.3%). Review North's discount and product mix.
5. Leakage is material: 583 orders (11.7%) were cancelled or returned, representing ₹1.41 Cr of gross sales. Net delivered sales are ₹10.73 Cr.
6. Segment mix: Consumer is 52.6% of sales, while Home Office is the most profitable per rupee (27.4% margin).
7. Data quality is good, not perfect: zero sales-formula mismatches, but 40 orders lack a region and 60 lack a payment mode. All 583 unrated orders are exactly the cancelled/returned ones.
8. Concentration risk is low: top-10 customers are only 3.4% of sales; 39.3% of customers generate 80% of revenue.

🎯 Recommendations

R1 — Cap deep discounts: require approval above 20%. Moving the >20% band to 11–20% pricing recovers about ₹387,359 without losing satisfaction.
R2 — Protect the top products: 4K Monitor and the next product are 41.2% of revenue. Build bundles to lift AOV from ₹24,276 and reduce single-product risk.
R3 — Fix North and learn from East: audit North's discounting and mix; copy East's 28.2% margin playbook.
R4 — Reduce cancellations and returns: target 11.7% → 8%. Review Same-Day shipping SLAs (3.91) and pre-dispatch quality checks.
R5 — Grow Home Office: highest margin at 27.4% with a smaller revenue base — a clear mix-shift opportunity.
R6 — Loyalty for the core: 852 customers (39.3%) drive 80% of revenue; retention here protects the base.
